profile.headline: Senior Laravel & React Full-Stack Developer
profile.subheadline: 8+ years building web, mobile and industrial systems — ERP, HRM, supply chain, e-commerce and SCADA.
profile.summary: Senior full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience building web and mobile applications for businesses. I specialize in Laravel & PHP (bug fixes, APIs, e-commerce, ERP modules), React (admin dashboards, SPAs, frontend integration), Flutter (Android apps with Laravel/REST backends), and Node.js (REST APIs and real-time features). I have delivered production systems including multi-vendor e-commerce, food delivery platforms, inventory/ERP tools, live chat (WebRTC), and enterprise HRM & supply chain software. I deliver clean maintainable code, fast replies, clear updates, and on-time delivery.

experiences.title: Senior Software Developer
experiences.summary: Building and maintaining the enterprise systems that run a poultry and hatchery operation end to end.
bullets: Build and maintain enterprise Laravel and React systems including HRM, supply chain, and attendance workflows.
Design REST APIs, integrate Flutter mobile attendance with JWT backends, and support PostgreSQL/MySQL production databases.
Ship Docker-based deployments and production support for ERP/SCM modules.

experiences.title: Senior Developer Team-Lead
experiences.summary: Leading web and mobile delivery, including decentralized blockchain products.
bullets: Lead development of web and mobile applications using React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
Coordinate team delivery, code review, and client-facing timelines for product features.
Contributed to decentralized web/mobile features including React, React Native, and real-time Node.js services.

experiences.title: Senior Software & PLC Developer
experiences.summary: Industrial software: PLC programming paired with web interfaces for monitoring and control.
bullets: Developed industrial software and web interfaces for PLC/SCADA environments (Siemens PLC-1214C, OPC-UA).
Built React and Node-RED integrations with MongoDB for monitoring and control workflows.
Delivered production-ready automation and web application features for engineering clients.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Laravel Developer
experiences.summary: Multi-vendor e-commerce platform work, from catalog to admin.
bullets: Developed a multi-vendor e-commerce platform with Laravel and Ajax.
Implemented admin features, catalog flows, and production bug fixes.
Maintained MySQL-backed application features for live business use.

experiences.title: Junior Software Developer
experiences.summary: Where it started: real-time communication systems and full-stack client work.
bullets: Built real-time live chat applications with Node.js, WebRTC, Socket.IO, and MongoDB.
Worked on full-stack web features and production support for client projects.
Grew from junior developer into delivering production Node.js and web systems.

partTimeExperiences.title: Project Manager
partTimeExperiences.summary: Ran client projects end to end while staying hands-on in the code.
bullets: Managed and developed Laravel applications including food delivery (CallBien) and OCR-based inventory (GlamourGlow).

Handled client communication, scope, and on-time project delivery.
